issues.description: v3-beta default speaker disagrees between code (shubh) and docs (aditya).
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh' for bulbul:v3-beta, but the module docstring, class docstring, README table, and PR description all state 'aditya'. Make the config the single source of truth and reconcile the docs (or vice versa) before landing.

issues.description: 'Ignored parameter' warnings use float equality against defaults instead of detecting explicit user input.
issues.detail: Checks like `params.pitch != 0.0` and `params.temperature != 0.6` conflate 'user passed default' with 'user passed nothing', producing both false positives and false negatives. Use pydantic's model_fields_set or an explicit None sentinel to determine whether a field was actually provided.

issues.description: voice_id is never validated against the model's allowed speakers despite the data being present.
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS carries a per-model speakers tuple and SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums exist, but __init__ accepts voice_id: Optional[str] with no membership check. A v2 speaker sent to v3-beta fails server-side instead of raising a clear client-side ValueError. Wire up the validation you already built the data for.

issues.description: Pace range is enforced in two contradicting places and silently clamped rather than rejected.
issues.detail: pace has Pydantic Field(ge=0.3, le=3.0) plus per-model pace_range plus a silent clamp+warning in __init__. A v3 user passing pace=2.5 passes validation then gets quietly clamped to 2.0. Bind the valid range to the model config and either reject out-of-range values or fold the constraint into a single source.

issues.description: input_audio_codec silently dropped from STT _connect with no explanation.
issues.detail: The previous code passed `input_audio_codec` to the SDK connect call; the new code removes it entirely. If v2.5 endpoints still require it this is a silent regression for existing saarika/saaras users. Document the reason in a comment/commit message or restore the key for models that need it.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown model names.
issues.detail: Any typo or future model name returns v2 speakers with no signal, masking errors as plausible-but-wrong answers. Raise KeyError/ValueError on unknown models (consistent with __init__) or return an empty list — the silent default contradicts the rest of the data-driven dispatch.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the core refactor — replacing substring matches on model names with ModelConfig/TTSModelConfig data tables — is the right direction and worth landing. Consensus verdict is NEEDS-WORK on five concrete issues before merge: the v3-beta default speaker contradiction between code and docs, the broken 'was this user-provided?' detection via float equality with defaults, missing voice_id validation against the per-model speaker tuples the PR just built, double-bookkeeping of pace ranges with silent clamping, and the undocumented removal of input_audio_codec from STT connect. Fix those plus the silent v2 fallback in get_speakers_for_model and the data-driven dispatch becomes honest end to end.
